items.gloss_en: a means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information
items.specific_reason: Media is plural of medium in this sense; singular English gloss and no plural cue are misleading.
items.suggested_fix: Use plural gloss 'means/channels of communicating information'; say plural of medium.

items.gloss_en: a basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated
items.specific_reason: Criteria is plural of criterion, but singular gloss 'a basis' mismatches the plural headword.
items.suggested_fix: Change English gloss to 'standards or bases for judgment (plural of criterion)'.

items.gloss_en: a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold
items.specific_reason: Accent and unaccented cafe are accepted spelling variants; noun coffee shop meaning aligns.
items.suggested_fix: No change; optional spell variant note.

items.gloss_en: a fractional monetary unit of Ireland and the United Kingdom; equal to one hundredth of a pound
items.specific_reason: Pence is plural monetary subdivision of pound; single-unit gloss mistakenly says 'a fractional monetary unit'.
items.suggested_fix: State plural of penny in UK currency; distinguish pence vs pennies.

items.gloss_en: a person employed to represent a business and to sell its merchandise (as to customers in a store or to customers who are visited)
items.specific_reason: Plural of salesperson is licensed morphologically, but English gloss says 'a person' singular.
items.suggested_fix: Use plural 'people who sell goods or services'.

items.gloss_en: made or shaped by working a material; an archaic past participle of work
items.specific_reason: Wrought iron is adjectival past-participial use, while stored POS v and work verb sense lack matching syntactic role.
items.suggested_fix: Mark attributive participial adjective and verify exact linked lexical sense.

items.gloss_en: the physical or mental ability to sustain prolonged effort
items.specific_reason: English and Chinese definitions are correct for stamina, but the linked oewn-stamen botanical sense is unrelated.
items.suggested_fix: Remap identity with versioned sense migration; never silent change.

items.specific_reason: Source double hyphen encoding corresponds to orthographic in-law; noun relation by marriage aligns.

items.gloss_en: free from liquid or moisture; lacking natural or normal moisture or depleted of water; or no longer wet
items.specific_reason: Dryer is a machine for drying or comparative adjective of dry; current adjective definition 'free from moisture' is base dry, not dryer.
items.suggested_fix: Disambiguate intended dryer noun vs comparative drier/dryer and correct sense and gloss.

items.gloss_en: a headlike protuberance on an organ or structure
items.specific_reason: Capita as plural of caput is not a singular 'headlike protuberance', and sentence/definition omit plural marking.
items.suggested_fix: Check headword plural and specialist caput sense; correct plural gloss or restrict.

items.gloss_en: electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target
items.specific_reason: Source x--ray represents hyphen encoding, not semantic mismatch; noun physical radiation sense aligns.

items.pos: past tense / past participle of verb (British spelling)
items.gloss_en: went from one place to another; British spelling of traveled
items.gloss_zh: 旅行了；行进过（travel 的英式过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: British inflected travel is correctly distinguished by question; family-level verb sense matches travel.
items.suggested_fix: No new sense repair; note past form.

items.gloss_en: a segment of garlic or a dried aromatic flower bud used as spice
items.specific_reason: Clove noun garlic segment/spice contradicts stored pos=v and source cleave verb sense.
items.suggested_fix: Map to clove noun sense via versioned identity fix.

items.gloss_en: a person or thing having the same function or characteristics as another
items.specific_reason: Diacritic normalization and hyphen encoding differ but source counterpart noun sense aligns.

items.gloss_en: a person who occupies land or a building without the owner's permission
items.gloss_zh: 擅自占用土地或房屋的人
items.specific_reason: Squatter noun of unauthorized occupier mismatches source squat adjective 'short'; inflection is not the intended source sense.
items.suggested_fix: Correct noun agent identity; do not infer from lemma derivation alone.

items.gloss_en: an official report (usually sent in haste)
items.specific_reason: Accent normalization matches communique and an official communication noun sense.

items.gloss_en: killed deliberately or violently; past tense of slay
items.gloss_zh: 杀死；杀害（slay 的过去式）
items.specific_reason: Irregular past of slay and murderous event align to source verb sense.

items.gloss_en: a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition
items.specific_reason: Crying commonly denotes shedding tears or the activity of calling out, while source cry noun is a single shout; inherited singular utterance gloss mismatches derived noun's default reading.
items.suggested_fix: Clarify 'shouting/crying out' and distinguish weeping; verify mapping of verbal noun to source event.
